description: Returns facts about a cruise port: country, port code, coordinates and how many routes call there. Use it when the user asks about a port of call or departure port. It does NOT provide excursions, sights, weather or transfer advice, and it knows only ports in the provider's catalogue.

handle.description: Consultation handle returned by a previous call (structuredContent.handle). Pass it on every call so wishes are remembered; omit it on the very first call.

language.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the provider's language.

name: port_info
title: Port facts
